Ⓐ: <<21044>>'s effect states that『this card is also still a Trap,』so if it's changed to face-down Defense Position it will be Set in the Spell & Trap Zone of its controller at that time. (The position that it's Set in is decided by its controller at that time.)

Also, <<5432>> can be activated even if the controller of <<21044>> has no available Spell & Trap Zone, and it will be sent to the Graveyard if there is no available Spell & Trap Zone when it resolves. (It's not treated as being sent to the Graveyard by an effect.)

Ⓑ: <<12194>> says that『this card is NOT treated as a Trap』, so it will be changed to face-down Defense Position as it is in that Monster Zone. (It will not be Set in the Spell & Trap Zone.)

Also, if that <<12194>> returns back to face-up position again, it will still be treated as a Normal Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0), but the『If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field』effect will no longer be applied. (<<12194>> will be affected by monster effects, and if it would be sent to the Graveyard due to being destroyed for example, it will be sent to the Graveyard as normal.)

ja.question:
モンスターゾーンに存在する以下のモンスターを対象として「<<5432>>」を発動した場合、どうなりますか？

（A）『①：このカードは発動後、通常モンスター（爬虫類族・地・星４・攻１６００／守１８００）となり、モンスターゾーンに特殊召喚する（罠カードとしても扱う）』効果によって特殊召喚された「<<21044>>」

（B）『②：罠カードが発動した時、その発動にチェーンしてこの効果を墓地で発動できる。このカードは通常モンスター（水族・水・星２・攻１２００／守０）となり、モンスターゾーンに特殊召喚する（罠カードとしては扱わない）。この効果で特殊召喚したこのカードはモンスターの効果を受けず、フィールドから離れた場合に除外される』効果によって特殊召喚された「<<12194>>」
